'''Vítor Luiz Faverani Tatsch''' (born May 5, 1988) is a Brazilian professional [[basketball]] player who plays for [[Basket Cartagena|Cartagena]] of the Spanish [[Primera FEB]]. He has also represented [[Brazil national basketball team|Brazil]] in international competition and holds a Spanish passport.<ref name=sportando>{{cite web|title=PE Valencia adds size with Vitor Faverani|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/87458/pe-valencia-adds-size-with-vitor-faverani.html|access-date=19 July 2011|work=Sportando.com|date=19 July 2011}}</ref>

==Professional career==

===Spain===
Faverani arrived in Spain at age 14 and started playing for [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja]]'s junior ranks. In 2005, he joined [[CB Axarquía|Clínicas Rincón Axarquía]] of the [[Liga Española de Baloncesto|LEB Oro]], the junior team of Unicaja. In 2006, he joined the Unicaja senior team where he made his [[Liga ACB]] debut during the 2006–07 season. He also spent time with [[Basket Zaragoza 2002|CAI Zaragoza]] in 2006–07, playing 24 games in the LEB Oro. For the 2007–08 season, he was loaned to [[San Sebastián Gipuzkoa BC|Gipuzkoa BC]]. In 2008–09, he played seven [[EuroLeague]] games for Málaga while also spending time with Clínicas Rincón Axarquía.

After going undrafted in the [[2009 NBA draft]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Único brasileiro no draft, Faverani encara "vestibular" da NBA sem pretensões|url=http://esporte.uol.com.br/basquete/ultimas/2009/06/22/ult4356u3831.jhtm|access-date=22 June 2009|work=Esporte.uol.com.br|date=22 June 2009|language=pt}}</ref> Faverani parted ways with Málaga on August 26, 2009.<ref>{{cite web|title=Faverani and Malaga part ways|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/cups/euroleague/78764/faverani-and-malaga-part-ways.html|access-date=26 August 2009|work=Sportando.com|date=26 August 2009}}</ref> The next day, he signed with [[CB Murcia]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Murcia adds size with Faverani|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/78770/murcia-adds-size-with-faverani.html|access-date=27 August 2009|work=Sportando.com|date=27 August 2009}}</ref>

After two seasons with Murcia, Faverani signed a two-year deal (with the option of a third) with [[Valencia Basket]] on July 19, 2011.<ref name="sportando" /> On September 1, 2012, he extended his contract with the club through the 2014–15 season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Valencia extends Vitor Faverani|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/94975/valencia-extends-vitor-faverani.html|access-date=1 September 2012|work=Sportando.com|date=1 September 2012}}</ref> However, following the 2012–13 season, he parted ways with Valencia in the hopes of signing in the NBA.

===Boston Celtics===
On July 22, 2013, Faverani signed a three-year deal with the [[Boston Celtics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/celtics/news/sidebar/072213-celtics-sign-faverani-pressey|title=Celtics Sign Faverani, Pressey|date=July 22, 2013|work=NBA.com|access-date=July 22, 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Spears|first=Marc|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/nba--celtics-to-sign-brazilian-c-vitor-faverani--200234509.html|title=Celtics to sign Brazilian C Vitor Faverani|date=July 15, 2013|work=Yahoo.com|access-date=July 22, 2013}}</ref> During his rookie season, he had multiple assignments with the [[Maine Red Claws]] of the [[NBA G League|NBA Development League]].<ref>{{cite web| title = 2013-14 NBA Assignments | work = NBA.com | url =http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2013_14.html| access-date = February 4, 2014}}</ref> On March 7, 2014, he underwent successful left knee arthroscopy to repair a torn lateral meniscus, subsequently sidelining him for the rest of the season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/celtics/news/press_release/vitor-faverani-medical-update|title=Vitor Faverani Medical Update|date=March 7, 2014|work=NBA.com|access-date=March 7, 2014}}</ref> On December 18, 2014, he was waived by the Celtics following the [[Rajon Rondo]] trade; he did not make an appearance for the Celtics in 2014–15.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/celtics/news/pressrelease/boston-celtics-complete-trade-dallas-mavericks|title=Boston Celtics Complete Trade With Dallas Mavericks|date=December 18, 2014|work=NBA.com|access-date=December 18, 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Forsberg|first=Chris |url=https://www.espn.com/blog/boston/celtics/post/_/id/4716433/celtics-release-vitor-faverani|title=Celtics release Vitor Faverani|date=December 18, 2014|work=ESPN.com|access-date=December 18, 2014}}</ref>

===Maccabi Tel Aviv===
On July 10, 2015, Faverani signed with the Israeli club [[Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Maccabi Tel Aviv inks center Faverani to one-plus-one deal|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/66vihdvpj5vwhw5p/maccabi-tel-aviv-inks-center-faverani-to-one-plus-one-deal|access-date=10 July 2015|work=Euroleague.net|date=10 July 2015}}</ref> On November 2, he was waived by Maccabi after appearing in only two official games.<ref>{{cite web|title=El Maccabi cortará a Vitor Faverani y renovará al frustrado fichaje del Estu Ike Ofoegbu|url=http://www.gigantes.com/el-maccabi-cortara-a-vitor-faverani-y-renovara-al-frustrado-fichaje-del-estu-ike-ofoegbu/|access-date=2 November 2015|work=Gigantes.com|date=2 November 2015|language=es|archive-date=December 26, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151226021049/http://www.gigantes.com/el-maccabi-cortara-a-vitor-faverani-y-renovara-al-frustrado-fichaje-del-estu-ike-ofoegbu/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

===Return to Spain===
On December 30, 2015, Faverani returned to [[CB Murcia|UCAM Murcia]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Vitor Faverani vuelve a casa|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=119021|access-date=30 December 2015|work=ACB.com|date=30 December 2015|language=es|archive-date=January 7, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160107074533/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=119021|url-status=dead}}</ref> On January 15, 2017, [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona Lassa]] bought him out, for €250,000, from UCAM Murcia<ref>{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/encestando/status/820991155848544256 |title=CONFIRMADO: el @FCBbasket ha pagado 250.000 euros más IVA por Faverani. |publisher=[[Twitter]] |language=es |date=16 January 2017 |access-date=16 January 2017}}</ref> and he signed a two-year deal with Barcelona.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fcbarcelona.es/secciones/baloncesto/primer-equipo/noticias/2016-2017/vitor-faverani-nuevo-jugador-del-barca-lassa |title=Vitor Faverani, nuevo jugador del Barça Lassa |publisher=FCBarcelona.es |language=es |date=15 January 2017 |access-date=15 January 2017}}</ref> On May 18, 2017, Faverani and Barcelona mutually parted ways.<ref>{{cite news|title=Acuerdo para la desvinculación de Vitor Faverani|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=131922|access-date=18 May 2017|work=Acb.com|date=18 May 2017|language=es}}{{Dead link|date=March 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

On July 26, 2017, Faverani returned to UCAM Murcia for the 2017–18 season.<ref>{{cite news|title=OFICIAL: Vitor Faverani vuelve para luchar en los Tercios del UCAM Murcia CB|url=http://www.ucamdeportes.com/ucamcb/noticias/oficial-vitor-faverani-vuelve-para-luchar-en-los-tercios-del-ucam-murcia-cb|access-date=26 July 2017|work=ucamdeportes.com|date=26 July 2017|language=es}}</ref> On August 26, 2018, Faverani signed a one-year deal with [[San Sebastián Gipuzkoa BC|Delteco GBC]] of the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{cite news |title=ACB.COM - Vitor Faverani vuelve a vestir los colores del Delteco GBC |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=142838 |access-date=26 August 2018 |work=www.acb.com |date=26 August 2018 |language=es-ES }}{{Dead link|date=March 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

===Flamengo===
In June 2021, Faverani returned to playing basketball after a three-year absence, when he signed a one-year contract in Brazil with [[Flamengo Basketball|Flamengo]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Reforço de peso: Flamengo anuncia contratação de Vitor Faverani, ex-NBA |url=https://www.lance.com.br/flamengo/reforco-peso-anuncia-contratacao-vitor-faverani-nba.html |access-date=4 December 2021 |work=Lance! |language=pt-BR}}</ref> He had been using the training facilities of team since January. It marked the first time Faverani played professionally in his native country.

In September 2025, Faverani signed for [[Basket Cartagena]] in the [[Primera FEB]], the second tier of [[Spanish basketball league system|Spanish basketball]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gigantes.com/primera-feb/vitor-faverani-fichaje-cartagena-primera-feb/|title=El FC Cartagena CB trae de vuelta a España a Vitor Faverani para jugar en Primera FEB|last=|first=|date=September 3, 2025|website=gigantes.com|publisher=|language=es|access-date=February 5, 2026}}</ref>
